column1: # group_of.tsv — an address and the group the platform puts it in (ADR 0053), read by tests/test_group_of_table.py, which
# builds the field and the grouping from the two declarations below — nothing of any subsystem's spec.
# The group is the HOST the address names, in one spelling: neither the scheme nor the port is part of it; lower case, no
# trailing dot; an IP as written once (IPv6 unbracketed, RFC 5952, no zone; IPv4-mapped as IPv4); a percent-escape in a
# host is not decoded; the host read by the field's `schemes` (a scheme outside the map has none). (none): no group.
# The only addresses without a group that are taken are the `none` ones; a host nobody can tell is refused, 400.
# This is the course's seed of the table, until «Паритет» replaces it with the table shared with the product.
# source: {type: url, schemes: {rtsp: {}, http: {}, file: {}, ipint: {fragment: none}, driverpack: {host: path, none: [file]}, mirror: {host: path, fragment: none, none: [local]}}}
# Columns, tab-separated: the source; its group, or (none); the fault of a write of it — empty (taken) or `bad_url`.
# one host, whatever the scheme and the port
# a login is not the host: refused, and on its host all the same
# no host to tell: no group, refused
# a scheme outside the map: no host is read for it, refused
# driverpack://<vendor>/<address>/…: the host is the path's first segment, and the vendor no part of it
# mirror://<hub>/<host>/…: the host in the path, `#` a character, `mirror://local/…` no host
